chapter: Local bands and Bunk's later jobs
title: Working for the Bronstrow family and rice and cane field work
summary: Bunk worked for the Bronstrow family near Weeks Hall late on, and drove tractors hauling rice and then cane.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: Day jobs: musicians working outside music

blocks.x: Oh, well I think of it, who was that family that you all worked for, that, uh,
The one in real... The Barmystrow. Yeah.
The Russian and the Barmystrow had a shirt plantation in Cuba or something. Uh-huh.
How's that name spelled again, do you know?
